description: This file defines the vCal class, a PHP class extending SugarBean, associated with handling iCalendar (VCAL) data, including functions for generating, parsing, and caching free/busy calendar entries within the SuiteCRM/SugarCRM system.

classes.name: vCal
classes.description: Represents a vCal entity, managing calendar data, free/busy scheduling, and iCalendar formatting within SuiteCRM.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the vCal object and disables row-level security.

methods.name: get_summary_text
methods.description: Returns an empty string as a summary placeholder.

methods.name: fill_in_additional_list_fields
methods.description: Placeholder for filling additional list view fields.

methods.name: fill_in_additional_detail_fields
methods.description: Placeholder for filling additional detail view fields.

methods.name: get_list_view_data
methods.description: Placeholder for retrieving list view data.

methods.name: get_freebusy_lines_cache
methods.description: Combines and returns all free/busy lines from related vCal entries for a user.

methods.name: create_sugar_freebusy
methods.description: Generates free/busy iCalendar data from SugarCRM meetings, calls, and tasks for a user within a date range.

methods.name: get_vcal_freebusy
methods.description: Generates a vCal string representing a user's free/busy schedule, optionally incorporating cached data.

methods.name: cache_sugar_vcal
methods.description: Static method to cache vCal data for a user.

methods.name: cache_sugar_vcal_freebusy
methods.description: Static method to cache free/busy vCal data for a user in the database.

methods.name: fold_ical_lines
methods.description: Folds long iCal lines to comply with RFC 5545 line length limits.

methods.name: create_ical_array_from_string
methods.description: Parses an iCalendar string into an array following RFC rules.

methods.name: create_ical_string_from_array
methods.description: Converts an array of iCalendar lines into a string with proper RFC 5545 formatting.

methods.name: escape_ical_chars
methods.description: Escapes special characters in strings for iCalendar format.

methods.name: unescape_ical_chars
methods.description: Reverts escaped iCalendar characters back to their original form.

methods.name: get_ical_event
methods.description: Generates an iCalendar VEVENT string for a calendar event, such as a meeting, suitable for email invitations.
